title: Protocol for DNA Extraction from Tepary Bean
author: Aparna Srinivasan

steps.title: Sample Collection and Freezing
steps.instruction: Collect 100 mg of young leaf from Tepary Bean plants into 2 ml Eppendorf tubes containing two sterile glass beads and freeze immediately in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 600 μl of pre-warmed CTAB buffer and proteinase K (20 mg/ml) to the sample, mix by gently inverting the tubes, and incubate in a water bath at 65 °C for 30 min.

substeps.instruction: Invert the tubes once every 10 min to homogenize the tissue and buffer.

steps.title: Lysate Recovery and RNA Treatment
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the incubated tubes at 14000 rpm for 15 min, transfer 500 μl of the cleared lysate to a new 1.5 ml tube, and treat with RNase (10 mg/ml) at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Phenol:Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Phenol:Chloroform to the sample, vortex well, and centrifuge at 14000 rpm for 15 min.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube, ensuring the lower layers are not touched.
Repeat the Phenol:Chloroform step if the aqueous phase is not clear.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the aqueous phase, mix very gently, and let stand for a few minutes to precipitate nucleic acids.

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet using Sodium Acetate and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 μl of 3M Sodium Acetate and 500 μl 70% ethanol, centrifuge at 14000 rpm for 5 min, and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl 70% Ethanol, centrifuge at 14000 rpm for 5 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: DNA Dissolution
steps.instruction: Air-dry the pellet and dissolve it in 50 μl TE Buffer.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Verify DNA quality and store the sample.

substeps.instruction: Run DNA on a 0.8% Agarose gel to check for degradation or RNA contamination (if RNA is present, treat with RNAse A and repeat from the phenol:chloroform step).
Measure nucleic acid concentration and purity (A260/A230 ratio) using a Nanodrop; a ratio of 1.8-2.0 indicates purity, while <1.8 indicates carbohydrate or phenol contamination.
Store DNA sample at -80 °C until use.
